text: 7-year-old boy. The patient has been experiencing recurrent episodes lasting 3–4 minutes each of facial grimacing and staring over the past month. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Absence Seizure (Note: While the "staring" and "unresponsiveness" mimic absence seizures, the duration of 3-4 minutes, post-ictal confusion, and specific aura (muddy taste) strongly suggest Complex Partial Seizures, likely temporal lobe in origin.
